query-mapping.description: Information about branches on a project.

query.name: project-branches
query.comment: Get a list of project branches.
query.sql: SELECT branch.id, branch.name, branch.tag, branch.last_date, build.create_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM porion_build AS build WHERE build.branch_id = branch.id) AS count FROM porion_branch AS branch LEFT JOIN porion_last_build AS last_build ON branch.id = last_build.branch_id LEFT JOIN porion_build AS build ON last_build.build_id = build.id WHERE branch.project_id = :project_id
